summary: GSK plc files Form 6-K to update on litigation between its subsidiary TESARO and AnaptysBio over a 2014 license agreement for dostarlimab (Jemperli). The Delaware Chancery Court granted AnaptysBio's motion to dismiss TESARO's anticipatory breach claim, but the merits of the contractual dispute remain unresolved. TESARO's declaratory judgment claim continues. No deal terms, acquisition, or special-situation restructuring are present; this is a routine litigation update.
